inputs.prompt: Reimagine this as an upscale restaurant marketing photograph of a private dining room, mid-event. Keep the room, furniture, wood hutch bar, long table with black tablecloth, chairs, flowers, wall-mounted TV and door exactly as they are - do not change the architecture or furniture layout. Remove all overlay UI chrome - no profile photo, no username, no timestamp, no close button, no navigation arrows, no thumbnail strip, no watermark text. Populate the room with a warm group of 8-10 diverse adult guests seated around the long table, mid-conversation and mid-meal, plates and glasses in front of them, candid natural body language, some laughing, some mid-bite. Turn the wall-mounted TV on to a warm ambient scene (soft abstract light, not distracting content). Warm the lighting throughout to an inviting golden restaurant glow. Photorealistic documentary event photography, natural candid moment.
